interface_notes.value: For the ultra-hard Fe-Mn-Al-Cu alloys, new BCC phase and FCC Cu-rich phase form at the interfaces between the β-Mn. As β-Mn is an Mn-rich phase, its nucleation/growth enriches Mn while expelling Fe, Al and Cu into the surrounding matrix; the BCC phase is attributed to Al enrichment (a BCC stabilizer) around β-Mn interfaces, while the Cu-rich phase forms due to the limited solubility of Cu in Fe-based alloys. TEM of a fully transformed 15Al condition shows the fine particles at the β-Mn interfaces are FCC and rich in Cu, depleted in Fe and Mn and slightly poor in Al.
